$comment: THE CANONICAL LAWS. One source. Every other document references this file rather than restating the list, because a law repeated in five places is a law that will eventually disagree with itself. tests/validation.test.mjs asserts that no other file in the repository restates the set, and that every module and test named below exists.

sequence.$comment: The four steps, in order. Each is a different question answered by a different part of the system, and collapsing any two of them is the failure BRAIN exists to prevent.

steps.means: A model can suggest what to do. A suggestion is not a fact and is never recorded as one.
Only recorded observations, resolved by the ordinary rules, make something established.
Evidence establishes what a system does; it does not decide what may happen or what the system is called. Domain-scoped authority does.
An action is not successful because it was attempted, acknowledged, or believed. Something has to be observed afterwards.

laws.prevents: A system whose knowledge dies with the context window it was learned in.
Confusing the thing that fetches facts with the facts. Removing every adapter must lose capability and lose no world.
Treating a crash as an erasure. A dead process is not a world that never happened.
A manifest entry being read as a working capability.
Routing consequential work on a declaration of availability rather than an observation of presence.
Capability being read as permission. One field holding both makes them one question.
Corroboration manufactured by reading one source twice.
The moment a record was appended standing in for the moment the thing happened.
Arrival order deciding truth, which is a rule that can be gamed by disconnecting.
Absence of an observation being read as an observation of absence.
Discarding something that was true when observed because it is old now.
A cached answer being served as a present-tense fact.
Wanting something being read as having authorised it.
A nested or wrapped call laundering a refusal the direct call would have received.

laws.law: Recovery is not success until verified
laws.prevents: A resumed action reporting completion it never established. SENT stays uncertain; EXECUTED never reads as VERIFIED.
A session continuing on what it relied on when it started, after the world moved.
A historical fact being asserted in the present tense.

laws.law: The owner must not be the continuity glue
laws.prevents: A system that only works while one person remembers what happened. If a human has to re-explain the world after every restart, the world is in the human.
